newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hot Topic more details.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hot Topic more details.

text.p: Alex Brown analyst Maria O'Shea said on Tuesday she downgraded her rating on the shares of Hot Topic Inc to a buy from a strong buy.
-- O'Shea said a lack of sales momentum removed some potential upside to the shares.

-- "We believe a difficult fiscal second half comparison, coupled with an apparent lack of sales momentum among existing stores, will lead to 'in-line' earnings results over the next two quarters," she said.
-- O'Shea said she remained positively impressed by Hot Topic's store concept, management team, demographic positioning, store economics and new-store performance.
